meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: Claude 会去查你存在 Claude-Mem(cmem.ai)里的持久记忆——过去各次会话留下的带时间戳观察记录,回答你之前聊过什么。它先做 1~3 次宽泛关键词检索,再用更具体的词缩小范围,最后用白话总结,不把原始搜索结果直接丢给你。
howto.when: 当你提到“search memory”、“你记得关于 X 的什么”、“上次会话我们做了什么”等说法,或想要某个项目、决策、文件、任务的既往会话上下文时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下记忆里关于这个项目的记录
say.note: 会在 cmem.ai 记忆里做关键词检索

say.text: 你还记得上次会话我们做了什么吗?
say.note: 会汇总观察记录并在需要时给出时间戳

say.text: 搜一下记忆里关于这个报错的信息
say.note: 先宽泛检索,再用具体词缩小范围

howto.what_en: Claude searches your persistent Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory of timestamped observations from past sessions. It runs broad keyword searches, narrows with specific terms, then answers in plain language rather than dumping raw results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say things like "search memory", "what do you remember about X", or "what did we do last session", or want prior-session context on a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search memory for what we did on this project
say_en.note: Runs keyword searches against cmem.ai memory

say_en.text: Do you remember what we did last session?
Search memory for that error message
say_en.note: Broad search first, then narrower terms
